patterns.name: Black header bar
patterns.description: 64px #000000 bar, full width. At 1136px and up: wordmark at x 80, six #111111 pills (14px/500, 36px tall, padding 10px 12px, 8px apart), the last one a menu button with a chevron; on the right a globe language pill, Help, Log in and a white Sign up pill. Below 1120px: wordmark, Log in, Sign up and a 36px round hamburger.

patterns.name: Product sub-navigation
patterns.description: White 64px bar under the header on product pages: 24px/700 page title on the left, five or so 14px #6b6b6b links on the right. On phones the title becomes a button with a chevron that opens the link list.

patterns.name: Two-column feature section
patterns.description: 1152px content split into two 558px columns with 36px gap: text block (36px h2, 16px body, 48px button) vertically centred on one side, a 558px wide image on the other; sides alternate.

patterns.name: Card row
patterns.description: Three 360px columns (36px gap) of image, 18px/500 title, 16px body and a black 48px button; on phones they stack.

patterns.name: Black footer
patterns.description: #000000 footer: wordmark, Visit Help Center link, four link columns at 297px pitch (18px/500 heading, 14px links every 36px), 48px social squares and language plus city buttons, store badges, then 12px #afafaf copyright and legal links.

layout.responsive: Three tiers. 1136px and up: 1280px container with 64px padding, two-column sections, 52px h1. 600 to 1135px: 32px gutter, sections stack or keep two columns, 44px h1, hamburger header. Below 600px: 24px gutter, one column, 36px h1, card rows become stacks or 3-up icon tiles, footer columns stack.

flows.layout: not recorded: auth.uber.com answered with a bot-protection interstitial ("Just a moment...") to the automated browser, so its first screen could not be measured.

screen: Header Log in (#111111 pill) and Sign up (white pill) are the only entry points observed on the marketing site

principles: Frame every page with the same black 64px header and black footer; switch only the middle between white and black.
Keep the palette greyscale: #000000, #111111, #f6f6f6, #ffffff. Colour comes from photos and illustrations, never from UI chrome.
Write headings in UberMove bold (52px h1, 36px h2) and keep body copy at 16px/24px; nothing in between except 18px/500 card titles.
Build sections as a 1152px content box: either a two-column text plus image pair or a heading over a three-column row.
Use pills (999px) for navigation and quick choices, 8px rectangles for the main call to action.
Indicate hover with an inset tint (rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.06) on light, rgba(236, 236, 236, 0.15) on dark), not a colour change.
End product pages with an FAQ accordion and an app download band before the footer.
avoid: Coloured buttons or brand-colour fills in the chrome
Rounded image corners or card shadows on content blocks
Centred marketing heroes; heroes are left-aligned with the image on the right
Thin or light headings; headings are always bold

detected.name: Base Web
detected.evidence: data-baseweb attributes on buttons and icons (data-baseweb="button", "icon")
